fieldValues.title: Several agents cannot be connected to one essay and instructed together
fieldValues.statement: I want Claude Code, claude.ai and ChatGPT connected to the same essay at the same time, each given instructions. For each agent I need to share, easily, how to work on the essay, and to edit rules specific to that agent, so that I can cut and paste them into a chat to restart it. Today each agent is told what to do in its own session, and nothing keeps its instructions with the essay.
